title: Applied ML and AI Engineer
description:
**About Our Client**

Our client is an established management consulting firm working with government, financial services, and enterprise clients across the GCC and wider MENA region. Their identity will be disclosed at first contact from Faze 3\.

**The Team You'd Be Joining**

A rapidly growing, ambitious AI engineering team being built from the ground up to design and ship the AI products at the centre of the client’s consulting work. As an early hire in this build, you will help shape both the technical foundations and the engineering culture of the function.

**The Role**

This role bridges classical machine learning and modern LLM\-based systems. You will build production ML models (regression, classification, time\-series, anomaly detection) alongside hybrid architectures combining retrieval\-augmented generation, ML scoring, and rules\-based logic. You will own the evaluation frameworks that keep applied AI honest in production: precision, recall, hypothesis testing, model diagnostics, drift detection.

This is a hands\-on practitioner role, not research. The team ships into live client engagements against measured precision, recall, latency, and cost targets.

**Mandatory Requirements**

**Education.** Bachelor’s in Computer Science (or very similar/related) OR Bachelor’s in Statistics (or very similar/related) from a Tier 1 / Tier 2 university. Master’s preferred. “Very similar/related” includes Software Engineering, Mathematics, Data Science, Physics, Applied Statistics, Information Systems, Econometrics, and similar substantively quantitative disciplines.

**Experience.** 5–10 years in applied ML / AI engineering, with at least 3 years building ML models that ran in production.

**Core technical.** 

* Strong Python
* NumPy, pandas, scikit\-learn
* Production ML pipelines
* SQL
* Working comfort with the LLM and RAG interplay.

**Statistical rigour.** Working fluency with hypothesis testing (t\-tests, z\-tests, chi\-square), time\-series and stationarity diagnostics (AD, JB, ARCH, ADF, KPSS), and model diagnostics (AIC, BIC, log\-likelihood).

**Conditional certification.** If your degree is in Statistics (or very similar/related), the role requires either the Stanford Machine Learning Specialization OR the IBM Python for Data Science and AI certification. For CS\-pathway candidates, these are good\-to\-have.

**Language**: English proficiency is required

**Desirable skills:**

* Time\-series modelling depth — ARIMA family, Prophet, deep\-learning sequence models.
* PyTorch or TensorFlow at working level.
* MLflow or equivalent experiment tracking in production use.
* Embeddings, vector search, and reranking experience.
* XGBoost, LightGBM, or CART model fluency.
* Drift detection, shadow evaluation, or A/B test design experience.
* A live GitHub or portfolio with original ML work.
* Arabic language capability.

Salary is highly competitive and dependent on your skills and experience.

**How to Apply**

Apply through this platform and we will contact you to direct you to our online application portal.

Job Types: Full\-time, Permanent

Pay: E£25,000\.00 \- E£135,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

description:
The Intelligence Presales Solution Architect serves as the primary technical authority for ZainTECH's Intelligent pillar, with a deep specialization in the Microsoft AI and Data platform. This role is responsible for designing solution architectures, leading technical discovery, building proofs of concept, developing technical proposals, and supporting deal progression from qualification through close \- working in close partnership with overlay sales specialists, account managers, and delivery teams.
 



 The ideal candidate combines hands\-on expertise across Microsoft's AI and Data stack (Azure AI Services, Azure Machine Learning, Azure AI Foundry, Microsoft Fabric, Azure OpenAI Service, Copilot Studio, Power Platform) with the consultative ability to translate business requirements into credible, deployable solution designs. They will be the technical voice in customer\-facing engagements, responsible for building confidence that ZainTECH can deliver on the Intelligent pillar promise \- from AI Readiness and Data Governance through Advanced Analytics, Generative AI, and Agentic AI.
 



 As a secondary competency, the candidate should be able to position and support technical conversations around two Microsoft\-native areas within ZainTECH's Digital pillar: Process Automation on Power Platform (covering finance, HR, customer service, and compliance automation) and Customer \& Partner Experience on SharePoint and Microsoft 365 (covering employee productivity, partner portals, and mobile\-first experiences). These are natural extension points where the Microsoft AI and Data stack intersects with Digital pillar workloads.
 



 Responsibilities:
 




 Technical Solution Design \& Architecture (Intelligent Pillar \- Microsoft Focus)
 



* Lead technical solution design for AI and Analytics engagements across the full Intelligent pillar value chain: AI Readiness (Data Quality \& Governance, Responsible AI, Organizational Readiness), Advanced Analytics \& Machine Learning, Generative AI (RAG, Co\-Pilots, Content Generation \& Personalization), and Agentic AI (Autonomous Reasoning, Multi\-Agent Orchestration, Agentic Governance).
* Architect end\-to\-end solutions on the Microsoft platform including Azure AI Services, Azure Machine Learning, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI Service, Microsoft Fabric (Data Factory, Data Engineering, Data Warehouse, Real\-Time Intelligence, Power BI), Copilot Studio, and the Power Platform.
* Design data platform architectures leveraging Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Data Lake Storage, Azure SQL, Cosmos DB, and Purview to support analytics\-ready, governed data foundations.
* Develop generative AI solution architectures incorporating Azure OpenAI Service, Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) patterns, prompt engineering, fine\-tuning strategies, and embedding\-based retrieval using Azure AI Search and vector stores.
* Design agentic AI architectures using Copilot Studio, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, and multi\-agent orchestration patterns with appropriate human\-in\-the\-loop governance and safety controls.
* Produce technical solution documentation including architecture diagrams, solution design documents, bills of material, sizing estimates, and implementation roadmaps for customer proposals and RFP responses.
* Define non\-functional requirements (scalability, security, performance, compliance) and incorporate them into solution architectures aligned with Microsoft Well\-Architected Framework principles.




 Customer\-Facing Technical Engagement
 



* Lead technical discovery workshops with customer IT, data, and business teams to assess current\-state architecture, data maturity, technology landscape, and AI readiness.
* Conduct solution presentations, architecture walkthroughs, and whiteboarding sessions with CTOs, CIOs, Chief Data Officers, Heads of AI, and enterprise architects to validate proposed designs and build technical confidence.
* Design, build, and deliver proofs of concept (PoCs) and proofs of value (PoVs) that demonstrate tangible outcomes \- such as a working RAG pipeline, a predictive analytics model on customer data, or an automated workflow using Copilot Studio \- to de\-risk the buying decision, when necessary.
* Support the AI Sales Overlay Specialist and account teams by providing technical depth during stakeholder conversations, helping quantify the technical effort and translating customer pain into architecture requirements.
* Deliver executive technical briefings and AI Readiness assessments that provide customers with actionable findings on their data governance posture, platform landscape, and AI adoption roadmap.




 Presales Process \& Deal Support
 



* Own the technical win strategy for AI/Analytics opportunities, defining the proof points, demonstrations, and reference architectures needed to secure technical selection.
* Develop scope definition, resource plans, and pricing inputs for professional services proposals in coordination with delivery and PMO teams.
* Author technical sections of proposals and RFP/RFI responses, ensuring accuracy, feasibility, and differentiation of the proposed Microsoft\-based solution.
* Build and maintain a library of reusable solution assets including reference architectures, PoC accelerators, demo environments, and technical battle cards for the Intelligent pillar on Microsoft.
* Participate in deal reviews and architecture review boards to ensure solution quality, deliverability, and margin protection.




 Process Automation on Microsoft Power Platform
 



* Design and demonstrate process automation solutions using Microsoft Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps, Power Pages) and AI Builder, addressing use cases across Finance \& Accounting Automation (invoice processing, reconciliation, expense management, month\-end close acceleration), HR Optimization (digital onboarding workflows, HR virtual assistants, automated offboarding), and Intelligent Customer Service Operations (omnichannel routing, agent assist, AI\-driven case deflection).
* Architect end\-to\-end automation workflows that combine Power Automate cloud and desktop flows with Dataverse, Copilot Studio, and Azure AI Services to deliver intelligent process automation (IPA) that goes beyond simple RPA \- incorporating document intelligence, natural language understanding, and decision automation.
* Support presales engagements for Automated Compliance \& Governance scenarios, designing solutions that leverage Power Platform, Microsoft Purview, and SharePoint to enforce policy workflows, audit trails, and regulatory controls.
* Identify and articulate the natural progression from process automation to AI \- for example, surfacing data quality issues during a finance automation engagement that create demand for an AI Readiness or Data Governance workload, or embedding predictive models into an automated supply chain workflow.




 Customer \& Partner Experience on SharePoint and Microsoft 365
 



* Design modern intranet, employee productivity, and knowledge management solutions on SharePoint Online and Microsoft Viva, addressing pain points around information fragmentation, context switching, disconnected hybrid culture, and uncontrolled tool proliferation.
* Architect Partner Portal and channel collaboration solutions using SharePoint, Power Pages, and Dataverse, enabling structured deal registration, content distribution, partner enablement, and pipeline visibility for customers managing indirect sales channels.
* Design Mobile\-First Experience solutions leveraging Power Apps, SharePoint, and Teams to digitize field data capture, enable mobile approvals and notifications, and extend enterprise system access to frontline and deskless workers.
* Position the natural integration between experience platforms and AI capabilities \- such as embedding Copilot for Microsoft 365 into employee productivity solutions, integrating Azure AI Search into SharePoint\-based knowledge portals, or layering RAG\-powered chatbots on top of partner and customer content repositories.
* Collaborate with Digital pillar presales engineers on joint solution designs where Microsoft 365 and Power Platform workloads create the foundation for downstream Intelligent pillar opportunities.




 Partner Ecosystem \& Continuous Development
 



* Serve as ZainTECH's primary technical liaison with Microsoft's AI and Data specialist sales teams, participating in joint technical briefings, partner technical workshops, and co\-sell engagements.
* Maintain deep currency with the Microsoft AI and Data platform roadmap, including new releases across Azure AI Foundry, Microsoft Fabric, Copilot Studio, and Azure OpenAI Service, and translate these into updated solution patterns and customer recommendations.
* Pursue and maintain relevant Microsoft technical certifications and contribute to ZainTECH's Microsoft AI specialization and competency attainment.
* Mentor junior presales engineers and delivery consultants on Microsoft AI solution design patterns, architecture best practices, and customer engagement techniques.
* Contribute technical content for thought leadership purposes including architecture blogs, solution briefs, and reference implementation write\-ups.

* Deep hands\-on expertise across the Microsoft AI and Data platform, specifically:
+ Azure AI Services (Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Search, Document Intelligence, Speech, Vision, Language)
+ Azure Machine Learning (Designer, Pipelines, MLflow integration, Managed Endpoints, Responsible AI dashboard)
+ Azure AI Foundry (prompt flow, model catalog, evaluation, deployment orchestration)
+ Microsoft Fabric (Data Factory, Data Engineering with Spark, Data Warehouse, Real\-Time Intelligence, Power BI)
+ Copilot Studio and Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps) for agentic and workflow\-driven AI solutions
+ Data governance tooling: Microsoft Purview (data catalog, lineage, classification, sensitivity labeling)

* Proven experience designing and delivering Generative AI solutions including RAG architectures, embedding pipelines, prompt engineering patterns, fine\-tuning workflows, and grounding strategies using Azure AI Search or equivalent vector retrieval systems.
* Strong foundation in data engineering and analytics architecture: data lakehouse patterns, medallion architecture, ETL/ELT pipeline design, dimensional modeling, and real\-time streaming.
* Hands\-on proficiency in Python, SQL, PySpark, and at least one ML framework (scikit\-learn, PyTorch, or TensorFlow) for building and demonstrating ML solutions.

description:
**Retire the ERP.**
 Light exists to replace factory\-era ERPs with software that feels alive. Our Smart Financial Platform gives modern, global companies superpowers—automated accounting, real\-time reporting, and financial flows that move at the speed of the business.
   

  

 We build with our customers, ship fast, and obsess over craft. In a short time, Light has gone from idea to the operating core for leading companies like Lovable, Legora, and Keyshot. People don’t just use Light—they enjoy it.
   

  

 We’re an early team defining a new software category. Think engineers who love debits and credits, designers who care about reconciliation states, and operators who treat finance as a product. If you’re excited to modernize how the world runs money—one workflow at a time—you’re in the right place.
   

  

 Backed by world\-class investors and advised by industry titans, we’re building category\-defining products with the freedom to ship ambitiously and own outcomes.
   

  

 Come help us make Light the global default for next\-gen finance.
   

  

**This AI Engineer role**
 We're looking for builders who can take a customer problem from idea to production, wherever in the stack it lives. At Light, AI writes code and the bottleneck has shifted from writing to thinking, so we want engineers who work end\-to\-end and ship things that matter.
   

  

 We are primarily hiring at mid\-level for this role. Junior candidates who are exceptional and genuinely AI\-native are welcome. Senior candidates will be considered by exception; we have strong technical leadership and the bar is high.
   

  

**Your qualifications:**
 2\-6 years of experience ideally, plus...
   

  

* You build things. Not prototypes, not demos. Working software in production, doing something real for real users. This is the non\-negotiable.
* You're genuinely AI\-native. You've changed the way you work because of AI tooling, not just added it to your workflow. You have an instinct for where it helps, where it misleads, and how to use it without losing ownership of the outcome.
* You've built with LLMs. You have hands\-on experience building products or features on top of large language models. Agents are a bonus, but working knowledge of how LLMs behave in production is a must.
* You're comfortable across the stack. You don't need to be a specialist in everything, but you can't have a lane you refuse to leave. Our stack is Kotlin and React. If you're strong in one and curious about the rest, that works. If you need someone else to handle the other side of the feature, it doesn't.
* You care about the product. You think about the person on the other end. You notice when something feels clunky, even if it technically works. You have opinions about what good software feels like and you act on them.
* You ship early and often. Small batches. Learn. Go again. You're not precious about your work. You'd rather put something real in front of a customer than spend another week perfecting it in isolation.


**Bonus points:**
* Experience in fintech or systems where data integrity is non\-negotiable
* Familiarity with accounting concepts: debits, credits, reconciliation
* Background in high\-growth startups where everything was still being figured out


**Our Tech Stack:**
 We build on AWS, with a Kotlin backend, a React frontend, and infrastructure managed in Terraform. It's a real production system that global finance teams depend on every day.
   

  

 You don't need to have used every piece of it. You do need to be comfortable in this kind of environment: real scale, real customers, real stakes.
   

  

**The good stuff**
 In addition to being part of a great team and working in a really fun and innovative environment, we offer:
   

  

 💸 A competitive salary \+ potential stock options
   

  

 🏝 25 days of annual leave \+ public holidays in the country where you are based.
   

  

 🥳 Regular socials and company off\-sites
   

  

 🚀 A huge opportunity for career growth as you'll help shape a market\-defining product.
   

  

**The famous last words**
 Working at Light means you're embarking on an exciting journey to reshape the future of multinational financial operations. Our cheat\-code is that we've built something like this before \- and are now doing it again, only better. Our goal is to make global finance effortless and empower companies to make informed decisions.
   

  

 Join the rocket ship while it's taking off 🚀

**1GLOBAL** 
  is a technology\-driven global mobile communications provider, delivering global connectivity solutions to enterprises and consumers.  We serve many of the world's leading banks, enterprises, and digital\-first businesses, including neo\-banks, global fast moving consumer goods companies, travel leaders, and payment service providers. Today, 1GLOBAL connects more than 
 **70 million people and devices globally** 
 , enabling our customers to launch, scale, and innovate with confidence in the mobile ecosystem.
 



  

 1GLOBAL is a profitable, fast\-growing business. With full\-year revenues in 2025 exceeding 
 **US$200 million** 
  and profits of over 
 **US$25 million** 
 , we generate strong cash flows to fund our growth allowing us to continuously invest in infrastructure, platform innovation, and global expansion. Recent years have marked a defining phase in our journey, with major enterprise and mass\-consumer client wins accelerating our evolution into a global mobile connectivity powerhouse, purpose\-built to enable consumer brands to enter and succeed with their own  aspirations to offer telecommunications services to their clients.
 



  

 Founded in 2022 by experienced technology entrepreneurs, Hakan Koç and Pyrros Koussios, 1GLOBAL has rapidly emerged as a European technology leader
 **shaping the future of global telecommunications** 
 . We operate as a fully regulated Mobile Virtual Network Operator (MVNO) in 12 countries and as a regulated telecom operator in an additional 28 markets. Headquartered in the Netherlands, with world\-class R\&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, our team of close to 
 **500 experts across 15 countries** 
  is united by a single ambition: to redefine global mobile connectivity through technology, scale, and execution excellence.
   

  

**About the Team** 




 We are building a new AI team within Engineering, tasked with driving AI adoption across 1GLOBAL. The team's primary mission is to design and operate an internal AI and knowledge platform that makes our collective knowledge accessible, searchable, and actionable. Beyond the internal platform, the team will contribute AI\-powered capabilities to our commercial product lines. 
 



 You will be one of the first engineers on this team, working alongside a dedicated product manager. This is a foundational hire: you will set the technical direction, make early architectural decisions, and build the systems that the rest of the AI function will grow on.
   

  

**About the Role** 



* Design and build 1GLOBAL's internal AI platform: RAG pipelines, vector search infrastructure, and conversational interfaces.


* Evaluate, integrate, and operate large language models (open\-source and cloud\-hosted) in production, balancing accuracy, latency, and cost.


* Build secure ingestion and indexing pipelines for internal knowledge sources (Confluence, SharePoint, document repositories, internal APIs) with appropriate access controls.


* Develop backend services and APIs that expose AI capabilities to internal users and, over time, to product teams building customer\-facing features.


* Establish engineering standards for the AI function: testing, deployment, monitoring, and model evaluation frameworks.


* Own the full development lifecycle from requirements through production monitoring, with a bias toward shipping and iterating.


**Requirements**

**About You** 



* 5\+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 2 years focused on AI/ML systems in production.


* Hands\-on experience building RAG pipelines, working with vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, Elasticsearch, or similar), and integrating LLMs into backend services.


* Strong backend engineering skills: API design, microservices, production operations at scale. Proficiency in Python expected.


* Practical experience with LLM fine\-tuning, prompt engineering, and evaluation methodologies.


* Comfortable with CI/CD, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and infrastructure\-as\-code.


* Familiarity with data security practices (PII handling, access controls, data classification). Experience in regulated environments (financial services, telecommunications, ISO 27001\) is an advantage.


* Telecommunications domain knowledge is a plus but not required.


* Strong communicator who can explain technical trade\-offs to non\-technical stakeholders. Fluent in English.


* Self\-directed and comfortable with ambiguity. You will be shaping the function, not joining a mature one.


**Benefits**

**Why 1GLOBAL?** 



* **Growth Opportunities:** 
  Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 100% year\-on\-year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs
* **Major Transaction Exposure:** 
  Be in the driver's seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry
* **Work with a Talented Team:** 
  From the Board and the Founders to the Senior Management Team, you will collaborate daily with the most capable and renowned external advisors, and constantly being exposed to talented and driven individuals
* **Dynamic Work Environment:** 
  Thrive in a collaborative, fast\-paced workplace where innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts
* **Professional Development:** 
  Work alongside industry experts to enhance your skills and knowledge in a cutting\-edge field
* **International Experience:** 
  Gain opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world as you grow within the company
* **Open Communication Culture:** 
  Join a team where your ideas are heard, and open dialogue is encouraged, fostering a supportive and transparent work environment
* **Get Things Done Attitude:** 
  Be part of a results\-driven team that values efficiency, creativity, and the drive to make a tangible impact in the industry



*1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer, we value your character as much as your talent. Diversity drives our innovation, and we offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment. We are excited for you to join our mission to revolutionise connectivity globally.*

title: Deployed AI Engineer
description:
**Who We Are**
 Helsing is a defence AI company. Our mission is to protect our democracies. We aim to achieve technological leadership, so that open societies can continue to make sovereign decisions and control their ethical standards.
   

  

 As democracies, we believe we have a special responsibility to be thoughtful about the development and deployment of powerful technologies like AI. We take this responsibility seriously.
   

  

 We are an ambitious and committed team of engineers, AI specialists and customer\-facing programme managers. We are looking for mission\-driven people to join our European teams – and apply their skills to solve the most complex and impactful problems. We embrace an open and transparent culture that welcomes healthy debates on the use of technology in defence, its benefits, and its ethical implications.
   

  

**The role**
 Software only matters when it is actively being used and making a difference. As a Deployed AI Engineer, you will be at the heart of this \- taking state\-of\-the\-art software and integrating it into complex systems. You will be defining and executing against the end\-to\-end outcome and all steps on the way to delivering novel capabilities in some of the most challenging environments around.
   

  

 For example: you collaborate directly with customer avionics engineers to understand the data structures and APIs used in aircraft mission control systems. Instead of being scared, you embrace the complexity of unfamiliar databases, APIs, or network protocols; you dig into the specification and use your creativity and ingenuity to implement adapters for integrating them with Helsing’s cloud infrastructure. By working closely with our partners and customers (both metaphorically and quite literally), you continuously evolve, improve, and operate Helsing software. You own the outcome end\-to\-end.
   

  

**The day\-to\-day**
 In close collaboration with our product teams, you will discover and formalise customer requirements, identify bugs, and ship the latest features directly to our users. Technology demonstrations are our chance to shine \- you will coordinate between customers, partners, and Helsing engineers to showcase Helsing’s software and AI capabilities in simulations or with real systems.
   

  

**You should apply if you**
* Have a degree in computer science, software engineering, electrical engineering, or other relevant fields.
* Have a broad understanding and creative use of computer systems; this is the Swiss army knife in Helsing’s toolbox of world\-class talent.
* Prefer asking questions over stipulating answers.
* Love figuring things out, digging deeper and deeper into unfamiliar systems until it finally clicks, and you understand how they work.
* Are not afraid of legacy systems and would rather make them work than give up and try to rewrite it all.
* Are comfortable with scripting languages such as Bash or Python and have experience with software engineering in C\+\+, Java, Rust, or similar.
* Can navigate and configure Linux systems and have an understanding of network stacks and database systems.
* If applying for Germany\- it is a requirement that you are able to speak business level or fluent German


*Note: We operate at an intersection where women, as well as other minority groups, are systematically* 
*under\-represented. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all the listed qualifications; ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points.*
**Nice to have**
* Experience with Rust and Python.
* Experience with container\-based, cloud\-native and edge application architectures.
* Experience with maintaining and operating production systems using Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, or similar.
* Experience with SQL, NoSQL, and streaming database systems.
* Experience with production ML systems.
* Bonus points: you have professional experience working in a defence context.


**Join Helsing and work with world\-leading experts in their fields**
* Helsing’s work is important. You’ll be directly contributing to the protection of democratic countries while balancing both ethical and geopolitical concerns.
* The work is unique. We operate in a domain that has highly unusual technical requirements and constraints, and where robustness, safety, and ethical considerations are vital. You will face unique Engineering and AI challenges that make a meaningful impact in the world.
* Our work frequently takes us right up to the state of the art in technical innovation, be it reinforcement learning, distributed systems, generative AI, or deployment infrastructure. The defence industry is entering the most exciting phase of the technological development curve. Advances in our field of world are not incremental: Helsing is part of, and often leading, historic leaps forward.

* A welcoming office environment with complimentary coffee, refreshments, fresh fruit, and healthy snacks.
* A company that embraces diversity and values different perspectives.


**Job Description**

**About You**




 Are you looking for an opportunity to work on meaningful, cutting\-edge projects at the intersection of agentic AI and responsible business conduct? Did you wonder what it would be like to work at a company where your contribution has a real, measurable impact \- and you are rewarded for it?
   

  





 If you have a passion for building production\-grade AI agents, MCP\-based tool ecosystems, and data\-rich AI workflows, then this is the perfect role for you! We value autonomy, allowing you to bring your innovative ideas to fruition in an inclusive, feedback\-oriented environment. Your work on agentic systems will directly contribute to advancing gloabl corporate responsibility through technology.
   

  





**Your Responsibilities**




 As our new Senior AI Engineer, you will play a crucial role in developing state\-of\-the\-art agentic systems and AI integrations within RepRisk’s Agentic delivery team. You will contribute to the design, implementation and operation of agentic and AI products within the company. Moreover, you will be:
   

  




* Designing and building single\- and multi\-agent production systems with planning, memory, and tool\-use capabilities that meet regulated\-industry compliance and auditability standards.
* Building and operating MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers using FastMCP and platform providers such as Databricks or Snowflake, with secure schemas and role\-based permissions.

* Implementing testing, evaluation, monitoring, and observability best practices for production agent systems (LangSmith / LangFuse, structured tracing, offline and online evaluation).
* Developing, integrating, and maintaining LLM\-powered microservices and APIs (Python, FastAPI, gRPC, Postgres) as part of broader production applications deployed on AWS.
* Identifying, testing, and adopting state\-of\-the\-art advancements in LLMs and autonomous agent architectures (e.g. reflection, planning, multi\-agent coordination, AWS Bedrock and Bedrock AgentCore).
* Collaborating closely with the Product Manager, Tech Lead, and domain experts to align technical solutions with user needs and business goals; supporting discovery, proposing improvements, and showing initiative beyond the assigned scope.


**Qualifications**

**You Offer**



* **Experience:** 
 5\+ years of hands\-on software engineering experience, with 2\-3 years building AI agents in production environments, ideally for high\-stakes or regulated industries (finance, legal, healthcare, etc.).
* **Education:** 
 A Master’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, or a related STEM field (or equivalent practical experience).
* **Agentic frameworks:** 
 Strong hands\-on experience building agents with LangChain and LangGraph (or equivalent orchestration frameworks) — including planning, memory, tool\-use, and multi\-agent patterns.
* **MCP expertise:** 
 Proven experience building and operating MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers using FastMCP, or on platform providers such as Databricks or Snowflake, with secure schemas, authentication, and role\-based permissions.
* **Python \& backend:** 
 Expert\-level Python skills and strong engineering fundamentals across backend systems, APIs, and data pipelines (FastAPI, Postgres / SQLAlchemy, gRPC, async IO, Databricks, testing).
* **Observability \& evaluation:** 
 Proficiency with observability platforms and evaluation frameworks for LLM applications (e.g. LangSmith, LangFuse), performance profiling, and optimization techniques for AI systems.
* **Engineering fundamentals:** 
 Solid understanding of software design principles (SOLID, DRY, KISS), Clean Code, and common architecture patterns; ability to translate them into maintainable production code.
* **Ownership \& drive:** 
 High sense of product ownership, taking full responsibility for assigned work end\-to\-end, supporting the Tech Lead and PM in discoveries, proposing improvements to existing services, and showing initiative. Strong responsiveness and reliability.
* **Continuous learner:** 
 Stays on top of the latest best practices in AI engineering and shares knowledge across the team.



 Additionally, the following are a plus:
   

  




* **AWS Bedrock \& AgentCore:** 
 hands\-on experience with AWS Bedrock and Bedrock AgentCore for managed agent deployments and tool orchestration.
* **Kubernetes:** 
 experience running containerized workloads on Kubernetes in production.
* **ML engineering:** 
 experience with classical ML / LLM engineering on large datasets — fine\-tuning, retrieval, and summarization pipelines over ESG\-scale corpora.
* **Coding agents:** 
 experience building software solutions with the support of coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, etc.) and leveraging them to accelerate delivery.
* **Mentorship:** 
 experience mentoring engineers and providing thoughtful, constructive feedback.


**Additional Information**

**Please note that we will only consider candidates with a valid work permit.**

title: Full-Stack AI Engineer
description:
**The Role**
 Work directly with the founding team to build and ship AI\-powered products that handle real logistics operations autonomously. You'll work across the full stack, from multi\-channel integrations and backend services to front\-end interfaces, while pushing our AI capabilities forward.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

* Build end\-to\-end features across our Python backend (FastAPI) and front\-end interfaces
* Design and improve multi\-step AI workflows that process real\-world logistics data
* Work with LLM APIs, agent architectures, and evaluation tooling in production
* Contribute to infrastructure, CI/CD, and system reliability as we scale
* Shape product and technical direction alongside the founders


 Who You Are
   

  

* You take full ownership, from concept to deployed, working feature
* You move fast, iterate constantly, and know when to shift toward robust, scalable systems
* You build with AI, not just around it. AI\-native development is how you work.
* You're comfortable with ambiguity and energized by small\-team impact


 What You Bring
   

  

* Strong software engineering fundamentals: Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, SQL, REST APIs
* Hands\-on experience with LLMs: prompt engineering, API integration, evaluation, and related tooling
* Familiarity with event\-driven architectures, message queues, or background job processing is a plus
* Experience with Docker, CI/CD, and cloud infrastructure
* Startup mindset: resourceful, fast, biased toward shipping


 Process
   

  

 We move fast. Expect a decision within one week.
   

  

**Step 1: Application** 
 Fill out the form with one thing we really care about: submit an AI coding session, a transcript or log from Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or whatever tool you use to build. It can be .md, .txt, a combination of multiple sessions, or a link to a hosted artifact.
   

  

**Step 2: Online Interview** 
 A single online conversation covering technical depth, problem\-solving, and team fit. No multi\-round gauntlet.
   

  

**Step 3: Technical Session (60 min)** 
 A live coding challenge where you build a small backend service from scratch using an AI\-coding assistant (we provide it). We'll observe how you work, then you walk us through your code and key decisions in the last 5 minutes.
   

  

**Step 4: Decision** 
 Feedback and potential start within one week of your interview.

Welcome to SSC Space \- the perfect workplace for those passionate about technology in general and space in particular.

* Good written and spoken English

* Support the engineering platforms used for Mission Control software development, integration, verification and maintenance.

* Maintain technical documentation for infrastructure, pipelines, processes and operational procedures.

title: Senior AI Engineer – Pre-training Data (f/m/d)
description:
**Our Mission**
 Aleph Alpha is one of the few companies in Europe doing serious foundation model pre\-training. Our customers \- in finance, manufacturing, public administration \- need models that understand German, meet European regulatory requirements, and work reliably in high\-stakes settings. We're building that in Heidelberg.
   

  

 We're growing our pre\-training team and hiring someone to passionately work on data: defining what goes into our models, building the systems that source and prepare it, and ensuring our training team has the highest\-quality data to push model capabilities forward.
   

  

**Team culture**
 At Aleph Alpha, we foster a culture built on ownership, autonomy, and empowerment. Teams and individual contributors are trusted to take responsibility for their work and drive meaningful impact. We maintain a flat organizational structure with efficient, supportive management that enables quick decision‑making, open communication, and a strong sense of shared purpose.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a Senior AI Engineer in Pre\-training Data, you will work across the full stack of data preparation \- from sourcing and acquisition to processing, filtering, and mixture design. Some weeks you'll be deep in data quality analysis, understanding what makes a corpus valuable and how its composition affects downstream performance on public and bespoke evaluation tasks. Other weeks you'll be optimising large\-scale processing pipelines or building tooling that gives the team visibility into what our models are actually training on. And some weeks you'll be reading the latest research on pre\-training data methods, translating findings into experiments you can run against our stack.
   

  

 We approach data work in an evidence\-based way. Decisions about filtering strategies, data mixtures, and quality thresholds are backed by ablations \- you'll design and run targeted experiments to validate that your data choices actually improve model outcomes.
   

  

 We are looking for someone that combines significant research experience (in industry or academia) with high engineering competence.
   

  

 Your work sits at high leverage: the data you source, curate and synthesize directly determines what our models learn, how well they perform, and where they fall short. You'll have direct influence on the models we ship.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities**
* Co\-Own data pipelines end\-to\-end: Design, build, and maintain the infrastructure that sources, processes, deduplicates, filters, and prepares pre\-training corpora at scale. Own the conversion from curated corpora to training\-ready streaming formats.
* Curate and compose data mixtures: Define and iterate on the data blends used for pre\-training \- balancing domains, languages, quality tiers, and licensing requirements to maximise model capability.
* Build data quality tooling: Develop classifiers, heuristics, and analysis frameworks that measure and enforce data quality across terabyte\-scale corpora. Monitor pipeline health and data quality metrics at scale.
* Close data gaps: Work with evaluation and post\-training teams to identify where model weaknesses trace back to data coverage, then source or generate the data needed to address them.
* Collaborate with post\-training: Partner closely with the post\-training team to ensure pre\-training data decisions support downstream fine\-tuning, alignment, and deployment goals \- data choices upstream shape what's possible downstream.
* Co\-Own German\-language data: Ensure deep, high\-quality coverage of German\-language corpora \- this is core to our value proposition, not an afterthought.
* Establish data\-to\-performance signal: Design and run ablation studies to validate data choices \- measuring how changes in composition, filtering, or sourcing affect pre\-training evaluation metrics and downstream capabilities.
* Take data transparency seriously: Maintain data lineage and provenance so the team knows exactly what went into each training run.


**Your Profile**
**Basic Qualifications**
* Track record of shipping impactful technical work \- whether that's research, infrastructure, or both.
* Strong Python skills and comfort with data engineering and ML infrastructure, including experience with deep learning frameworks, workflow orchestration, object storage, columnar data formats, and distributed processing.
* Ability to reason about what a dataset contributes to model training and whether it matters \- not just process data, but understand it.
* Ownership mentality: you see problems through from diagnosis to solution to deployment.
* Willingness to relocate to Heidelberg or travel at least fortnightly.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with large\-scale data processing for ML, including corpus sourcing, curation, cleaning, deduplication, and filtering.
* Familiarity with data quality methods: classifier\-based filtering, heuristic scoring, perplexity\-based selection, and decontamination.
* Understanding of foundation model training \- how data composition, scale, and mixing ratios affect capabilities.
* Experience with web\-scale data sourcing and crawl processing (e.g., Common Crawl, WARC pipelines).
* Rust proficiency (parts of our data pipeline are performance\-critical).
* Infrastructure knowledge \- experience with Kubernetes, container orchestration, or cloud\-native ML infrastructure.
* PhD in machine learning, NLP, data engineering, or a related field (valued but not required \- we care about what you can do).
* Bonus, but not required: German language proficiency can be helpful for curating and assessing German\-language data.

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

The AI Platform Team enables Awin teams to build, ship, and operate AI\-powered products safely, consistently, and efficiently.

We are looking for a **Senior AI Platform Engineer \- Security \& Governance** to join the AI Platform Team and help define and implement the guardrails, privacy patterns, governance mechanisms, and safe defaults that allow AI adoption to scale responsibly across Awin.



In this role, you will work on the safety and control layer of AI development: AI security patterns, privacy and PII handling guidance, provider and model governance, reusable guardrails, and lightweight readiness mechanisms that improve safety without creating unnecessary process.



This role is best suited to someone who combines strong engineering judgment with real practical experience in security, governance, privacy, or compliance for AI\-powered systems. * Help shape Awinʼs approach to privacy, PII handling, and data\-safe patterns for AI workflows

title: AI Engineer - Insurance
description:
Some AI roles focus on experimentation. This one focuses on making it work in delivery.
 



  





 We are looking for an
 **AI Engineer** 
 to join NTT DATA and help implement the AI backbone that supports how work gets done: from code analysis and requirement refinement to automated gap analysis and specification generation. This is a role for someone who is comfortable turning AI from a promising capability into something robust, scalable, and useful inside real delivery contexts.
 



  





 You will work on the layer that enables AI to interact effectively with codebases, architectures, and delivery processes. That means configuring and orchestrating models and agents, improving the quality of AI\-driven outputs, and helping shape an engineering approach where prompt design, architecture knowledge, and software rigor come together.
 



  





 At NTT DATA, you will do that in a company that combines global reach with a human\-scale way of working. We are a team of more than 139,000 professionals across more than 50 countries, working on technology and consulting challenges across industries including financial services, industry, utilities, public sector, and healthcare. Our ambition is not only to deliver results to clients, but to do it through collaboration, innovation, and meaningful professional growth.
 



  





**What makes this opportunity different** 




 This is not a purely research\-oriented AI role, and it is not a conventional software engineering role with AI added on top.
 



  





 It is a role for someone who can:
 


* implement the AI delivery backbone behind real engineering workflows,
* configure, train, and orchestrate AI models or agents on top of existing codebases,
* improve automated gap analysis, requirement refinement, and specification generation,
* and ensure outputs are reliable enough to support real teams and real business needs.



  





 You will work very closely with the Intent Engineer, forming a strong techno\-functional pairing between business intent and AI\-enabled technical execution.
 



  





**Your mission** 




 You will be responsible for implementing and evolving the AI backbone that supports delivery, ensuring that AI\-driven outputs are robust, scalable, accurate, and usable across insurance\-related transformation work.
 



  





**Your day\-to\-day** 



* Configure, train, and orchestrate AI models and agents on top of existing codebases.
* Enable automated gap analysis, requirement refinement, and specification generation.
* Improve the robustness, scalability, and accuracy of AI\-driven outputs.
* Work closely with the Intent Engineer to iterate, validate, and finalize specifications.
* Apply AI\-native engineering practices to delivery scenarios, not just experimentation.
* Use Claude or similar LLMs inside engineering workflows, including IDE\-based usage.
* Design and refine prompts for code analysis, generation, and improvement.
* Contribute to architectures involving APIs, integrations, microservices, and event\-driven components.



  





**What we are looking for** 



* 4\+ years of experience in software engineering, AI engineering, applied GenAI, or a similar hands\-on technical role.
* Familiarity with AI\-native engineering practices, including approaches similar to Gastown.
* Hands\-on experience with Claude or similar LLMs.
* Experience using LLMs directly within IDEs and development workflows.
* Strong prompt engineering capability applied to development tasks such as code analysis, code generation, and refinement.
* Strong grounding in modern software engineering patterns, especially:
* API design and integration,
* microservices architecture,
* event\-driven and integration modules.
* Experience working with existing codebases and enabling AI\-driven analysis on top of them.
* Understanding of prompt engineering as a practical engineering tool, not just an experimentation layer.
* Ability to work closely with both technical and techno\-functional profiles in iterative environments.
* Experience in insurance or regulated enterprise environments will be especially valuable.
* Professional level of English.



  





**What you will find at NTT DATA** 




 At NTT DATA, growth happens through meaningful work, real ownership, and exposure to challenges that matter. Our talent approach is built around three pillars: creating a sense of belonging, enabling continuous development, and pushing innovation through an AI\-first mindset. That means working in teams where each voice matters, learning continuously, and contributing to end\-to\-end solutions that have real impact on clients and society.
 



  





**You will join a company where:** 




  




* collaboration is part of how delivery happens,
* learning is expected and supported,
* innovation is practical and connected to business value,
* and your growth is linked to the quality of the challenges you take on.



  





**Benefits** 




 As part of the Spain collective, you will have access to benefits designed to support flexibility, wellbeing, savings, and community, including:
 



  




* hybrid and flexible working model,
* Flex remote\-work support,
* flexible compensation options,
* nursery voucher options through flexible compensation,
* training support,
* corporate private health insurance for you, with strong coverage for eligible beneficiaries,
* life and accident insurance,
* mental health support programs,
* sports activities,
* discounts portal and additional banking and insurance advantages.



  





**Why this role, why now** 




 AI can accelerate delivery, but only when it is built into engineering with rigor. That is what makes this role important. You will help turn models, prompts, and agents into a reliable delivery capability that teams can use with confidence. Not as a demo. Not as a side experiment. As part of how modern engineering gets done.
 



  





 If you are looking for a role where you can combine software architecture, LLM enablement, prompt engineering, and real\-world delivery impact in insurance, this is a strong place to keep growing.
 



  





 Make this the place where you grow.

* **Product\-Centric Development:** 
 Designing and executing experiments to improve GenAI capabilities. This isn't just about "accuracy" in a vacuum—it's about optimizing for user value, reliability, and cost\-effectiveness.

 Leading the strategy for when, and if, to move beyond simple prompting. You will oversee supervised fine\-tuning (SFT) and Parameter\-Efficient Fine\-Tuning (LoRA) workflows to adapt models to our specific product domains.
* **Performance \& Cost Engineering:** 
 Balancing the "Quality\-Cost\-Latency" triangle. You will find ways to maintain high\-quality outputs while optimizing token usage and reducing inference latency.

 Expert\-level

title: Automation and AI Engineer
description:
**About the role**  

  

This role exists to design, build and operate the automations, integrations and AI\-driven tooling that support both internal operations and client delivery. Sitting at the intersection of engineering, operations and emerging AI capability, the Technical Automation \& AI Engineer is accountable for turning repetitive, manual or error\-prone processes into reliable, measurable automated workflows. Working within a mid\-level capacity, this role collaborates closely with engineering, consulting and operations teams, contributing directly to improved efficiency, reduced error rates and increased delivery throughput across the business.

### **Key responsibilities**

* Design, build and maintain end\-to\-end automation workflows across internal tooling using appropriate low\-code and no\-code platforms, ensuring solutions are reliable, scalable and fit for purpose.
* Develop robust integrations between SaaS systems by applying sound understanding of APIs, authentication methods and event\-driven patterns to enable seamless data flow across business systems.
* Build internal tools, scripts and lightweight services to bridge gaps between off\-the\-shelf platforms and operational needs, selecting the right approach between code and automation platforms.
* Identify and implement opportunities to embed AI and LLM capabilities into workflows, applying practical and production\-ready patterns for use cases such as document processing, summarisation and classification.
* Partner with stakeholders to understand processes, assess inefficiencies, prioritise opportunities and deliver measurable improvements in time saved, accuracy and operational performance.
* Own the end\-to\-end reliability of solutions by implementing logging, monitoring, alerting and secure configuration practices, alongside maintaining clear operational runbooks.
* Contribute to engineering quality by writing clean, maintainable and version\-controlled code and configurations, while supporting the development of internal standards and reusable components.
* Champion security, data protection and responsible AI practices across all automation and integration work.
* Support internal tooling and platform decisions by working with senior technical stakeholders to evaluate and guide technology choices.
 **Who you are and how you’ll make an impact**  

  

You bring experience from a software engineering, automation, integration or internal tooling environment where you have delivered practical solutions that improve efficiency and reduce friction. You are comfortable working hands\-on across both low\-code platforms and traditional programming languages such as Python or TypeScript, making thoughtful decisions about when each approach is most effective.

  

Your experience working with APIs, webhooks and authentication patterns allows you to confidently integrate systems and design reliable workflows, while your exposure to common SaaS tools means you understand the realities of operational environments. You are familiar with modern AI and LLM tooling and can apply it pragmatically, focusing on safe, cost\-effective and production\-ready use rather than experimentation alone.

  

You operate with a strong sense of ownership, taking problems from discovery through to delivery and iteration. You communicate clearly with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders, translating needs into solutions and documenting your work in a way that enables others to understand and build on it. Your approach balances pragmatism with curiosity, allowing you to continuously improve systems while contributing to a culture of learning and experimentation.

 **A day in the life**  

  

A typical day involves working closely with stakeholders across operations, delivery and technical teams to progress automation initiatives already prioritised within the business. You might start by refining an automation workflow, improving its reliability through better logging or error handling, before moving on to building an integration between two SaaS platforms using APIs or webhooks.


Throughout the day, you collaborate with engineers and consultants to ensure solutions align with broader delivery goals, while also contributing to discussions around tooling, architecture and AI use cases. You may spend time prototyping an AI\-enabled workflow, such as analysing internal communications or processing documents, before iterating it into a production\-ready solution.


You regularly engage with data and reporting needs, working with teams such as finance or operations to transform manual processes into automated, insight\-driven workflows, often leveraging cloud platforms. Alongside delivery, you maintain and improve existing automations, ensuring they remain secure, reliable and easy to operate, while documenting your work and contributing to shared standards.

### **Explore our Culture and Values in action**


Equal Opportunities  

  

At Tecknuovo, we’re committed to creating an inclusive, barrier\-free recruitment process and working environment for everyone. We want all candidates to have the best possible opportunity to succeed throughout their application. As a Disability Confident Committed employer, we actively encourage conversations about reasonable adjustments and will invite shortlisted candidates to share any adjustments they may need during the recruitment process.

A fantastic set of investors that has helped build some of the world's largest companies.


Our team in London is growing and we're looking for talented people to join us on our journey.

**AI at Duffel**
----------------


Travel is one of the most demanding domains for AI. A single trip can span multiple airlines, hotels, payments, policies, and time zones — and when something goes wrong, travellers need answers fast. We're building a chat\-based AI assistant that helps travellers manage trips booked through Duffel: changing a flight, understanding a fare rule, recovering from a disruption, getting a receipt — all the things that today mean a phone call or a long wait.


Behind that experience sits a platform: the orchestration, retrieval, memory, and evaluation systems that let agents reason reliably over real bookings, real money, and real policies. As a senior AI Engineer, you'll help build that platform from the ground up and set the technical direction for how we build agents at Duffel.

-------------------------

* **Design, ship, and own production\-grade AI agents** end\-to\-end — from intent through to taking action against Duffel's APIs — and define the agent development lifecycle the rest of the team will follow.
* **Build the core platform that powers our agents:** the orchestration engine, runtime, and primitives that define how agents reason, take actions, and interact with users — keeping them steerable and verifiable while staying conversational and adaptive.
* **Make agents trustworthy.** Build the retrieval and grounding systems that ensure responses are accurate, and the evaluation frameworks that let us measure and improve agent quality deliberately rather than vibes\-first.

title: Senior Developer
description:
At Hymans Robertson, we’ve established a dedicated AI team to partner with teams across the firm and unlock the potential of AI in practical, meaningful ways. We’re already delivering production AI solutions that streamline processes, enhance client experiences and augment colleagues’ day\-to\-day work — and we’re continuing to grow our capability at pace.


We’re looking for a Senior Developer / AI Engineer who can join us and hit the ground running: taking ownership of well\-scoped AI engineering tasks, collaborating closely with others, and delivering high\-quality, secure and measurable outcomes in a fast\-paced, innovative environment.


We invest in the latest technologies to support our ground\-breaking solutions, including Microsoft Azure’s AI platform and modern GenAI tooling. You’ll work as part of a highly skilled team that values engineering excellence and uses an agile approach to software development.

*\*We are open to considering candidates on a part time or full\-time basis\**

**What will your role look like?**


You’ll help design, build, deliver and run world\-class AI\-enabled solutions across the firm. Day to day you will:

* Work alongside high\-performing, multi\-disciplinary teams to turn real business problems into scalable AI\-enabled products and features.
* Be part of a DevOps culture that promotes autonomy, engineering excellence and continuous improvement, using modern tooling and practices.
* Design and implement systems across a range of programming environments and platforms — primarily .NET and Microsoft Azure (including Foundry).
* Build and iterate GenAI/LLM\-powered features (such as copilots, assistants and automation), keeping a clear focus on measurable business outcomes.
* Bring your experience across the full software development lifecycle — from shaping ideas through to secure, reliable production delivery.

**Though this is a varied role, your key tasks will include:**

* Designing and delivering AI\-enabled solutions and services that are secure, maintainable and built to scale.
* Implementing retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) patterns — including chunking strategies, embeddings and vector search — to ground responses in firm knowledge.
* Defining and running evaluation approaches (e.g., accuracy, grounding, toxicity, bias), and implementing guardrails, logging and monitoring to support production AI systems.
* Applying prompt engineering and responsible AI practices, partnering with stakeholders to ensure data protection, security and compliance requirements are met.
* Pragmatically assessing trade\-offs and barriers in the delivery of significant software systems.
* Leading non\-functional improvement work (for example, performance profiling).
* Driving innovation and increasing the maturity of frameworks, integrations and automations.
* Mentoring and coaching less experienced team members.

**To enjoy and succeed in this role, you will have:**

* Hands\-on AI engineering experience (or equivalent practical delivery experience).
* Practical experience delivering solutions on Microsoft Azure’s AI stack.
* A strong engineering mindset with test\-driven development practices.
* Experience with .NET, Azure, APIs, microservices, DevOps and GenAI tooling.
* Confidence working across the full software development lifecycle.
* A collaborative, curious and proactive approach, with strong communication skills.


\*Please note that as part of the recruitment process for this opportunity, candidates will be expected to complete a clean code exercise\*

*We would also encourage applications from candidates who perhaps do not possess all the attributes and experience listed above but are competent with the majority and would be able to quickly develop the additional skills and experience required in post with our full support. We would also love to hear about other knowledge and experience you may have that is not listed but could be of interest.*

**In addition to a competitive salary and access to our profit share scheme, we offer:**

* A flexible selection of employee benefits, so you can choose a package that best matches your lifestyle and needs.
* A collaborative and encouraging work environment where your thinking and ideas are encouraged.
* On site mental health and wellbeing assistance.
* A commitment to helping you develop both personally and professionally, with mentoring opportunities and access to our award\-winning learning portal, Aspire.
* Regular social activities, in addition to three days paid volunteering leave each year and a day’s leave to celebrate your birthday.
* Hybrid working so you can enjoy the positive wellbeing of working from home as well as the benefits of meeting colleagues in our sociable, modern office environments – with the expectation of two ‘in\-office’ days per week.
* A flexible working window, allowing colleagues the freedom to work flexibly between the hours of 7am and 7pm.


Please note, we recruit on a rolling basis so early applications are recommended to avoid disappointment.


We work alongside employers, trustees and financial services institutions, offering independent pensions, investments, benefits and risk consulting services, as well as data and technology solutions.


That's the who and the what. More important is the 'why'. The work we do may not always seem the sexiest. But it's difficult, it's complex, and it's important. We help our clients, their employees, members and customers make decisions that have real and direct consequences on their financial futures.


For 100 years we've taken this responsibility seriously. Together, as a team and with our clients and partners, we're here to build better futures.

* Fine\-tune, optimize, and deploy large language and multi\-modal models with a focus on performance and latency
* Build scalable MLOps pipelines and full\-stack applications to support robust, production\-grade AI deployments
* Guide multidisciplinary teams and clients through strategic decisions in AI engineering and GenAI adoption

* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, AI, or related STEM fields
* Hands\-on experience deploying LLMs and multi\-modal models at scale
* Strong engineering background in Python with proven backend and API development skills
* Solid understanding of scalable MLOps, observability, and cloud\-native AI deployment
* Excellent communication, problem\-solving, and project management skills in agile environments

* Experience with agentic frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex)
* Experience in deep learning frameworks and front\-end development
* Familiarity with Langfuse, Langsmith, or other LLM observability tools
* Understanding of Model Context Protocol and bias/hallucination mitigation techniques
* Previous success in integrating GenAI solutions into enterprise\-scale systems

* Deliver high\-impact technology solutions for Tier 1 financial institutions
* Work in a collaborative, flat, and entrepreneurial consulting culture
* Access continuous learning, training, and industry certifications
* Be part of a team shaping the future of digital financial services
* Help shape the future of digital transformation across FS \& Energy.

 We offer a competitive, people\-first benefits package designed to support every aspect of your life:
 



  




* Core Benefits: Discretionary bonus, competitive pension, health insurance, life insurance and critical illness cover.
* Mental Health: Easy access to CareFirst, Unmind, Aviva consultations, and in\-house first aiders.
* Family\-Friendly: Maternity, adoption, shared parental leave, plus paid leave for sickness, pregnancy loss, fertility treatment, menopause, and bereavement.

* Extra Perks: Gympass (Wellhub), travel insurance, Tastecard, season ticket loans, Cycle to Work, and dental insurance.

 We’re committed to making our recruitment process accessible and straightforward for everyone. If you need any adjustments at any stage, just let us know \- we’ll be happy to help. We value each person’s unique perspective and contribution. At Capco, we believe that being yourself is your greatest strength. Our \#BeYourselfAtWork culture encourages individuality and collaboration – a mindset that shapes how we work with clients and each other every day.

Elevation Capital is a group of internationally impactful companies spanning consumer packaged goods, hospitality, technology, real estate, non\-profit, and venture funding. **IDEAL CANDIDATE**
-------------------


The ideal candidate is an engineer who has shipped real products in small, fast\-moving teams and is comfortable owning problems end\-to\-end with minimal direction.


They combine strong technical fundamentals with a bias toward action and a track record of building systems that people actually use. They are comfortable working across the stack and are naturally drawn to applying AI in practical, high\-impact ways.


This individual is self\-directed, resourceful, and capable of moving from ambiguous problems to working solutions without waiting for detailed instructions.

**THE OPPORTUNITY**
-------------------


Elevation Capital is building an AI\-first operating layer across the business to eliminate manual work and increase speed across every team.


As an Applied AI Engineer, you will design and build the systems that power this transformation. This includes intelligent mobile applications, AI\-driven interview tools, voice agents, and data pipelines that connect and automate workflows across the organization.


Everything you build will be internal, proprietary, and deployed into production. You will see your work used in real time by teams across the business.

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**
------------------

* Design and build AI\-powered internal tools from concept to production
* Develop LLM\-driven workflows for interview intelligence, summarization, and decision support
* Build and ship cross\-platform mobile applications using React Native
* Develop backend systems and APIs to support AI workflows and real\-time data processing
* Build and deploy RAG pipelines and integrate vector\-based retrieval systems
* Develop voice agents and real\-time AI interfaces where applicable
* Identify manual workflows across teams and replace them with scalable automation
* Own projects end\-to\-end, including architecture, implementation, and iteration

* 2 to 5 years of experience building and shipping real products in small teams
* Strong Python skills with the ability to build production\-ready systems
* Hands\-on experience working with LLMs in real applications
* Comfortable working across the stack when needed
* High ownership mindset with minimal need for direction
* Able to operate effectively in fast\-moving, evolving environments

**TECH STACK**

Frontend and Mobile

* React Native (iOS and Android)
* React and Next.js
* Three.js and WebGL


Backend and APIs

* Python (primary)
* FastAPI or Django
* Node.js
* REST and GraphQL


AI and LLM

* RAG pipelines
* LLM orchestration frameworks
* Vector databases
* Real\-time voice systems


Data and Infrastructure

* Microsoft Fabric and Azure
* ETL pipelines and SQL
* Docker and Azure Container Apps
* Git

**REQUIREMENTS**

* Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
* Proven experience shipping production\-level applications
* Strong Python skills (will be assessed)
* Experience building and deploying applications (mobile or web)
* Demonstrated ability to independently solve problems and deliver working systems

**WHAT WILL SET YOU APART**

* Experience with RAG pipelines or vector databases
* Experience with voice or real\-time AI systems
* Background building internal tools or automation systems
* Strong portfolio of shipped projects (professional or personal)

This position offers a competitive salary based on experience, along with benefits including health coverage and opportunities for career growth in a rapidly expanding company.

 🎯 Is This Opportunity Right for You?
   

  

 Before reading further, ask yourself three questions. Your honest answers will tell you whether this is the right fit.
   

  

**① Do you have the ambition to grow a career, not just hold a job?**
 SIA is structured like a top\-tier professional services firm. We recruit entry\-level talent with a single long\-term objective: to develop your potential into a working equity partner, earned on merit, over the forthcoming years.
   

  

**② Are you passionate about leveraging technology to raise the bar on performance?**
 At SIA, the role is more thinking than doing. You are always "on," though not in the sense of working overtime. You are always observing, wondering: "How could my clients benefit from this?" You seek improvements before anyone asks.
   

  

**③ Do you have the drive to invest meaningfully in your own success?**
 We value thinkers who raise the bar through insight, not hours. Your contribution is measured by how well you learn, adapt, anticipate, and deliver — not by how long you sit at your desk. Fail fast. Reflect. Improve. That is our culture.
   

  

**If you answered yes to all three, we want to hear from you.**
 🏢 About SIA Innovations
   

  

 SIA Innovations is a boutique digital transformation consultancy operating at the forefront of AI and hybrid cloud adoption. Our mission is to propel organisations into the future with intelligent, user\-centred solutions built primarily on IBM's enterprise technology stack.
   

  

 Strategically located in the heart of downtown Montréal, with underground access to the Metro and REM, we work alongside Fortune 500 companies and leading public\-sector organisations across Québec, Ontario, the Caribbean, and the United States. We guide these organisations in reimagining their business models, modernising their operations, and building AI\-first, data\-driven enterprises.
   

  

*Our purpose: continuously raising the bar of expected business performance through applied, technology\-enabled innovation.*
 📋 The Role
   

  

 As a System Architect (Apprentice), you design and orchestrate systems. A system may be traditional software, an autonomous AI agent, a human workflow, or a hybrid of all three. You work alongside SIA's clients to map business outcomes onto executable system designs: deciding what agents handle, what people handle, and how they collaborate. Your primary outcome is a verifiable, adaptive system architecture that delivers business value with fewer lines of human\-written code.
   

  

 This is a 16\-month structured apprenticeship designed for driven recent graduates ready to launch their careers at the frontier of AI\-driven system design and enterprise technology. It combines hands\-on client project work with dedicated learning, building architectural range and technical depth progressively.
   

  

*Beyond project responsibilities, you are expected to invest a minimum of 8 hours per week in structured internal learning across cognitive skills, interpersonal development, industry knowledge, and technical expertise. Staying current with the evolving landscape of AI and enterprise technology is a core expectation, not an optional extra.*
 💼 What You Will Do
   

  

 Your responsibilities at SIA are a direct expression of the firm's five core values. We hire for attitude and behaviour first; technical skills are developed on the job. Each value shapes how you contribute day to day:
   

  

 Value Creation — Continuously seek better ways to serve clients and improve systems
   

  

* Design AI\-agent system architectures from ambiguous client needs, turning vague objectives into executable, verifiable blueprints

 🧠 Skills That Will Help You Thrive
   

  

 We hire for talent and attitude. Technical skills can be developed; character cannot. Candidates are evaluated across four dimensions:
   

  

 ① Hard Skills — Your Academic and Technical Background
   

  

* Degree: Bachelor's in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. Minimum 3\.5 GPA required; a master's degree is an asset.

 ⚡ The Fast\-Track Apprenticeship (FTA) Program

 The FTA Program is a structured 16\-month apprenticeship designed to develop a high\-potential recent graduate into the next generation of transformation consultant. ***Note:**

 📈 Career Growth and the Partner Path
